test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

She told me that she would come to the party.

options.text: She said, “I am coming to the party.”
She said, “I was coming to the party.”
She said, “I have to come to the party.”
She said, “I will come to the party.”

solution:
The correct answer is **"She said, “I will come to the party.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence **“She told me that she would come to the party” **is in indirect speech.
 
• In this sentence, **“She” **is the subject, **“told” **is the verb, and **“me that she would come to the party” **is the object.
 
• When we convert an indirect sentence into direct speech, the object of the indirect sentence becomes the subject of the direct sentence.
 
• The verb is changed to a form of **“say” **followed by the exact words that were said.
 
• In the case of the sentence **“She said, ‘I will come to the party’”, “She” **is the subject, **“said” **is the verb, and **“‘I will come to the party’” **is the object.
 
• This is the simple future tense. It implies that the action of coming to the party will happen at some point in the future.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **
